gaps.sentence: I'd like to know when the results ___ be published.
gaps.explanation: Future in a noun clause: when the results will be published.

gaps.sentence: He denied ___ the vase, though the camera saw him.
No matter how hard he pulled, he ___ open the drawer.
___ the whole, the trip was a great success.

gaps.explanation: 'make somebody do' — bare infinitive after the object.

gaps.sentence: ___ of my parents speaks French, so I translate for them.
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of' = not one and not the other (two people).

gaps.sentence: He was sacked ___ repeatedly arriving late.
